question: How can the one reality abiding in all beings transcend meditative objectification?
premises: One reality abides in all beings
It is not to be meditated upon
It is devoid of any object of meditation
inference: The one reality present in all beings transcends being an object of meditation.
plain_english: Indeed, the one reality abiding in all beings is not to be meditated upon and is devoid of any object of meditation.
